switching.title: Switching from OneTab?
switching.lead: Your lists come across as groups, titles and all. Nothing leaves your browser.

steps.export: In OneTab, open Export / Import URLs and press Copy to clipboard.
steps.save: Paste it into a plain-text file (Notepad, or TextEdit set to plain text) and save it as .txt.
steps.open: In TabMerger, open Settings → Data, press Import and choose the .txt file.
steps.import: Confirm. Each OneTab group becomes its own group, named “Imported 1”, “Imported 2” and so on.
steps.other: Coming from another tool? Export your bookmarks as HTML, or a JSON file, and import that the same way.
